data.one_liner: iOS implementation of the google_maps_flutter plugin using Google Maps SDK 10.
data.what_it_does: Provides the iOS-specific implementation for the google_maps_flutter plugin using Google Maps SDK 10. It replaces the default implementation when explicitly added to an app's dependencies.
use_when: You need to use Google Maps SDK 10 on iOS for your Flutter application.
Your application targets iOS 16 or newer as required by Google Maps SDK 10.
avoid_when: Your application requires an iOS deployment target lower than iOS 16.
You are authoring a package rather than an application.
strengths: Uses Google Maps SDK 10 on iOS.
Automatically replaces the default implementation for google_maps_flutter.
weaknesses: Requires updating the application's minimum iOS deployment version to iOS 16.
Not recommended for use inside package dependencies.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency in pubspec.yaml, specify your Google Maps API key in ios/Runner/AppDelegate.swift, and update the minimum iOS deployment version to iOS 16.

alternatives.name: google_maps_flutter_ios
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use if you need the default iOS implementation with lower iOS version requirements.

alternatives.name: flutter_map
alternatives.why_pick_it: Use if you want an open-source map solution using tile layers without Google Maps dependency.

data.minimal_example:
dependencies:
  flutter:
    sdk: flutter
  google_maps_flutter: ^2.0.0
  google_maps_flutter_ios_sdk10: ^2.19.0
